preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
Each test case must have an even number of dominoes n between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in dominoes)
preconditions.description: All numbers on the dominoes must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if len(set(a for a, b in dominoes)) == n // 2 and len(set(b for a, b in dominoes)) == n // 2 else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if the dominoes can be divided into two sets with unique numbers, otherwise 'NO'.
